people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: For Yahweh says: “Behold, he will fly as an eagle, and will spread out his wings against Moab.
translations.bsb: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, an eagle swoops down and spreads his wings against Moab.
translations.kjv: For thus saith the LORD; Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread his wings over Moab.
translations.asv: For thus saith Jehovah: Behold, he shall fly as an eagle, and shall spread out his wings against Moab.
